_comment: Local reference copy — synced from live n8n on 2026-06-11 (V1.1 pass). Live ID: bJcO5ox2u190bxTr. Hourly: reads Appointments, computes 24h/2h reminder windows (Luxon DateTime, America/New_York, DST-safe), sends personalized SMS, flags sheet to prevent duplicates. AI lead-scoring refs removed in V1.1; legacy Date.UTC(...)+5h hardcoded-EST timestamp logic replaced with Luxon-based CONFIG.DEFAULT_TIMEZONE handling.
name: Appointment Reminders

value.Reminder 24h: ={{ $("Build Reminder Batch").item.json.reminderType === "24h" ? $("Build Reminder Batch").item.json.sentAt : $("Build Reminder Batch").item.json.existingReminder24 }}
value.Reminder 2h: ={{ $("Build Reminder Batch").item.json.reminderType === "2h" ? $("Build Reminder Batch").item.json.sentAt : $("Build Reminder Batch").item.json.existingReminder2h }}

parameters.content: This workflow runs hourly, retrieves all appointments, identifies which ones need a 24-hour or 2-hour reminder (computed in America/New_York time, DST-safe via Luxon), sends a personalized SMS to each contact, and flags the appointment record so reminders are never duplicated.
